summary.en: Find the named animal, step over to it, and describe what you notice.
summary.zh: 找到被点名的动物，走过去，说说它的特征。

setup.en: Lay 3–8 animal tiles separately in an open area. Leave room for waiting beside the route.
setup.zh: 用 3–8 片动物垫排开放路线或散点，旁边留等候位置。

text.en: An adult names a visible animal, such as the penguins.
text.zh: 成人说出图上可见的动物，例如企鹅。

text.en: Point to the matching animal, then walk to its tile.
text.zh: 指向对应动物，再走到那片地垫。

text.en: Describe one feature, then let another player choose the next animal.
text.zh: 描述一个特征，再让下一人选择动物。

en: An adult names a visible animal, such as the penguins.
Point to the matching animal, then walk to its tile.
Describe one feature, then let another player choose the next animal.
zh: 成人说出图上可见的动物，例如企鹅。
指向对应动物，再走到那片地垫。
描述一个特征，再让下一人选择动物。

easier.en: Use three tiles and allow pointing instead of naming.
easier.zh: 只用三片，允许指认，不要求说名字。

variation.en: Give a habitat clue or try an animal movement with Move Like an Animal.
variation.zh: 加入栖息地线索，或转到动物模仿秀。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Choose an animal, copy a simple movement, and let a friend guess.
summary.zh: 选一只动物，模仿简单动作，让同伴猜。

setup.en: Place animal tiles separately, with a clear space beside them for waiting and movement.
setup.zh: 动物垫单层分开放，旁边留出等候和动作空间。

text.en: One player points to an animal without saying its name.
text.zh: 一人指向动物，不先说名字。

text.en: Try a gentle penguin sway or a slow turtle step, with adult guidance.
text.zh: 在成人引导下轻轻摇摆模仿企鹅，或慢步模仿海龟。

text.en: Friends guess the animal, then swap roles. One child uses a tile at a time.
text.zh: 同伴猜动物，然后交换角色；每片一次一人。

en: One player points to an animal without saying its name.
Try a gentle penguin sway or a slow turtle step, with adult guidance.
Friends guess the animal, then swap roles. One child uses a tile at a time.
zh: 一人指向动物，不先说名字。
在成人引导下轻轻摇摆模仿企鹅，或慢步模仿海龟。
同伴猜动物，然后交换角色；每片一次一人。

easier.en: Name the animal first and demonstrate together.

variation.en: Let children invent a new movement and explain it.
variation.zh: 让孩子自创一个动作，并说明规则。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Add one sentence at each animal stop to build a shared story.
summary.zh: 每到一个动物站点，接一句共同的故事。

setup.en: Use 3–8 animal tiles in a short line or gentle curve, with all borders visible.
setup.zh: 用 3–8 片动物垫排短直线或缓弯，保持边界可见。

text.en: Name the first animal and start a story: “The lion went on an adventure.”
text.zh: 认第一只动物并开头：“狮子去冒险了。”

text.en: At the next animal, add what happened next. Players may pause to press and observe the liquid.
text.zh: 到下一只动物时接续情节，也可停下按压观察液体。

text.en: Take turns until the last stop, then give the story an ending.
text.zh: 轮流讲到最后一站，给故事一个结尾。

en: Name the first animal and start a story: “The lion went on an adventure.”
At the next animal, add what happened next. Players may pause to press and observe the liquid.
Take turns until the last stop, then give the story an ending.
zh: 认第一只动物并开头：“狮子去冒险了。”
到下一只动物时接续情节，也可停下按压观察液体。
轮流讲到最后一站，给故事一个结尾。

easier.en: For a younger child aged 3+, pointing or adding one word is enough; an adult carries the story.
easier.zh: 三岁起的简化版可只指认或补一个词，由成人接续故事。

variation.en: Let children choose the order and create their own storytelling rule.
variation.zh: 孩子决定站点顺序和接故事规则。

skills.zh: 语言表达、想象、顺序理解。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Agree on color-to-action rules, then listen and try each movement.
summary.zh: 先约定颜色对应的动作，再听指令完成。

setup.en: Use 3–8 Color Duos tiles with clear access around them. Choose visible colors together.
setup.zh: 用 3–8 片双色垫，周围留通道，一起确认可见颜色。

text.en: Choose gentle actions: blue means slow steps, yellow means tiptoe, green means pause.
text.zh: 约定简单动作：蓝色慢步，黄色踮脚，绿色停住。

text.en: An adult calls a color. One explorer tries the matching action while others wait.
text.zh: 成人喊颜色，一位探索者完成动作，其他人在旁等候。

text.en: Swap the caller and explorer. Start with two color rules before adding another.
text.zh: 交换发令者和探索者，先用两条规则再增加。

en: Choose gentle actions: blue means slow steps, yellow means tiptoe, green means pause.
An adult calls a color. One explorer tries the matching action while others wait.
Swap the caller and explorer. Start with two color rules before adding another.
zh: 约定简单动作：蓝色慢步，黄色踮脚，绿色停住。
成人喊颜色，一位探索者完成动作，其他人在旁等候。
交换发令者和探索者，先用两条规则再增加。

easier.en: Use one action and show it before each turn.
easier.zh: 只用一个动作，每轮先示范。

variation.en: Let a child suggest a new color-action pairing.
variation.zh: 孩子提出新的颜色与动作对应。

skills.en: Color choices, listening and switching actions.
skills.zh: 颜色辨认、听指令、动作切换。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Watch a short color route, repeat it, then swap the leader.
summary.zh: 看一段颜色路线，记住并复现，再交换领路人。

setup.en: Lay 3–8 tiles in an open layout; make a waiting spot beside the route.
setup.zh: 用 3–8 片垫子排开放布局，旁边设等候点。

text.en: The leader chooses and walks a three-step color route.
text.zh: 领路人选一段三步颜色路线并走一遍。

text.en: The next player watches, then repeats the same sequence.
text.zh: 下一人观察，再按相同顺序走。

text.en: Swap leaders. Add another step only when everyone is ready.
text.zh: 交换领路人，准备好后再加一步。

en: The leader chooses and walks a three-step color route.
The next player watches, then repeats the same sequence.
Swap leaders. Add another step only when everyone is ready.
zh: 领路人选一段三步颜色路线并走一遍。
下一人观察，再按相同顺序走。
交换领路人，准备好后再加一步。

easier.en: Start with two stops and point out the route together.
easier.zh: 从两站开始，一起指认路线。

variation.en: Try four or five stops, or let the group build a new sequence.
variation.zh: 增加到四五站，或一起设计新顺序。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Design a color route and decide what happens at each stop.
summary.zh: 设计颜色路线，为每一站约定任务。

setup.en: Start with 3–8 tiles. Everyone waits off the play area while an adult helps arrange them.
setup.zh: 准备 3–8 片，所有人在区域外等候，成人协助摆放。

text.en: Children suggest a line, grid or curve; an adult helps place each tile flat without overlap.
text.zh: 孩子提出直线、方阵或缓弯，成人协助单层平放，不重叠。

text.en: Choose a simple task at each station, such as walk slowly, point to a color or pause.
text.zh: 每站定简单任务，如慢步、指颜色或停留。

text.en: Explain the route, invite a player to try, then step aside before changing the layout.
text.zh: 讲清规则、邀请试玩，退出区域后再修改布局。

en: Children suggest a line, grid or curve; an adult helps place each tile flat without overlap.
Choose a simple task at each station, such as walk slowly, point to a color or pause.
Explain the route, invite a player to try, then step aside before changing the layout.
zh: 孩子提出直线、方阵或缓弯，成人协助单层平放，不重叠。
每站定简单任务，如慢步、指颜色或停留。
讲清规则、邀请试玩，退出区域后再修改布局。

easier.en: Use three stations with the same task.

variation.en: Let a partner change one rule and explain the new route.
variation.zh: 同伴改一条规则并介绍新路线。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Take gentle steps, pause to notice a pattern, and continue at your own pace.
summary.zh: 轻轻落脚，停看纹理，再按自己的节奏继续。

setup.en: Lay 3–8 Aqua Tones tiles in a short path beside a quiet space. Keep away from furniture legs and doorways.
setup.zh: 在安静空间旁用 3–8 片 Aqua 垫排短路线，避开家具腿和门口。

text.en: Choose a blue or green tile as the start.
text.zh: 选蓝色或绿色垫作为起点。

text.en: Walk to the next tile with gentle footfalls. There is no race.
text.zh: 轻轻走到下一片，不竞速。

text.en: Pause to notice the liquid, then continue. In a reading nook, keep the route beside the books.
text.zh: 停看液体，再继续；阅读角版本让路线留在书架旁，不压书本。

en: Choose a blue or green tile as the start.
Walk to the next tile with gentle footfalls. There is no race.
Pause to notice the liquid, then continue. In a reading nook, keep the route beside the books.
zh: 选蓝色或绿色垫作为起点。
轻轻走到下一片，不竞速。
停看液体，再继续；阅读角版本让路线留在书架旁，不压书本。

easier.en: Use three nearby stations and walk with an adult.
easier.zh: 三站距离适中，成人陪同。

variation.en: Let another player choose the next color; rearrange only after everyone steps aside.
variation.zh: 让下一人选颜色，大家退出后再换布局。

skills.zh: 速度调节、身体意识、观察。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Stand steadily on each island, pause, then walk to the next stop.
summary.zh: 在每座小岛上站稳停留，再走到下一站。

setup.en: Use a short route of 3–8 Aqua tiles with manageable steps and a waiting space.
setup.zh: 用 3–8 片 Aqua 垫排短路线，步距适中，旁边留等候区。

text.en: Walk to the first island with both feet supported.
text.zh: 走到第一座小岛，双脚稳稳站好。

text.en: Pause for three seconds in a comfortable two-foot stance. An adult stays nearby.
text.zh: 双脚舒适站稳，停留三秒，成人在旁。

text.en: Walk to the next island and repeat; change explorer after the route.
text.zh: 走到下一站重复，完成路线后换人。

en: Walk to the first island with both feet supported.
Pause for three seconds in a comfortable two-foot stance. An adult stays nearby.
Walk to the next island and repeat; change explorer after the route.
zh: 走到第一座小岛，双脚稳稳站好。
双脚舒适站稳，停留三秒，成人在旁。
走到下一站重复，完成路线后换人。

easier.en: Make the pause shorter and offer an adult hand.
easier.zh: 缩短停留，成人可伸手协助。

variation.en: Try a different comfortable arm position while keeping both feet supported.
variation.zh: 保持双脚站稳，尝试不同舒适手臂姿势。

skills.en: Balance, controlled posture and body awareness.
skills.zh: 平衡、姿势控制、身体意识。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Keep a slow step–pause rhythm along a short route.
summary.zh: 沿短路线保持慢步、停留的节奏。

setup.en: Arrange 3–8 Aqua tiles in a short line or gentle curve with clear access.
setup.zh: 用 3–8 片 Aqua 垫排短直线或缓弯，留出通道。

text.en: Agree on “slow step, pause, continue” and demonstrate once.
text.zh: 约定“慢步、停留、继续”，先示范一次。

text.en: Walk the route at that pace. Stepping on the floor between tiles is allowed.
text.zh: 按约定节奏走；垫子之间可以踩地面。

text.en: Take turns and compare the rhythms you tried, without ranking speed.
text.zh: 轮流尝试，说说节奏，不排名快慢。

en: Agree on “slow step, pause, continue” and demonstrate once.
Walk the route at that pace. Stepping on the floor between tiles is allowed.
Take turns and compare the rhythms you tried, without ranking speed.
zh: 约定“慢步、停留、继续”，先示范一次。
按约定节奏走；垫子之间可以踩地面。
轮流尝试，说说节奏，不排名快慢。

easier.en: Try two stations with an adult setting the pace.

variation.en: Let a child suggest a different slow rhythm for the group.
variation.zh: 孩子设计另一种慢节奏。

skills.en: Pacing, attention to a sequence and movement control.
skills.zh: 节奏、顺序注意、动作控制。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Imagine at an animal stop, move at a color stop, and pause at an Aqua stop.
summary.zh: 动物站想象，双色站行动，Aqua 站停留。

setup.en: Use two tiles from each collection: six in total. An adult arranges an open route while everyone waits aside.
setup.zh: 每系列取两片，共六片；大家在旁等候，成人排开放路线。

text.en: At an animal tile, name a character or try a gentle animal movement.
text.zh: 到动物垫时，说角色或模仿简单动作。

text.en: At a Color Duos tile, complete an agreed action, such as slow steps.
text.zh: 到双色垫时，完成约定动作，如慢步。

text.en: At an Aqua tile, pause and describe the pattern; repeat the three roles along the route.
text.zh: 到 Aqua 垫时停看纹理，沿路线重复三种角色。

en: At an animal tile, name a character or try a gentle animal movement.
At a Color Duos tile, complete an agreed action, such as slow steps.
At an Aqua tile, pause and describe the pattern; repeat the three roles along the route.
zh: 到动物垫时，说角色或模仿简单动作。
到双色垫时，完成约定动作，如慢步。
到 Aqua 垫时停看纹理，沿路线重复三种角色。

easier.en: With two collections, choose two distinct roles; follow the route together.
easier.zh: 只有两系列时，明确两个不同角色，一起走。

variation.en: Ask children to change one station rule and explain the switch.
variation.zh: 孩子改一站规则，并说明变化。

skills.en: Switching rules, imagination and remembering tasks.
skills.zh: 规则切换、想象、任务记忆。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Choose story, movement and pause rules, then invite someone to try your adventure.
summary.zh: 自选故事、动作和停顿规则，再邀请同伴试玩。

setup.en: Use two tiles from each collection. Children suggest the route; an adult helps arrange it while others wait off the area.
setup.zh: 每系列两片，孩子提出路线，成人协助摆放，其他人在区域外等候。

text.en: Choose the characters or story for the animal stations.
text.zh: 为动物站选择角色或故事。

text.en: Choose a simple action or color order for the Color Duos stations.
text.zh: 为双色站选择简单动作或颜色顺序。

text.en: Choose what to notice at the Aqua stations. Explain all rules, try the route, then revise together.
text.zh: 为 Aqua 站决定观察什么；讲清全部规则、试玩，再一起修改。

en: Choose the characters or story for the animal stations.
Choose a simple action or color order for the Color Duos stations.
Choose what to notice at the Aqua stations. Explain all rules, try the route, then revise together.
zh: 为动物站选择角色或故事。
为双色站选择简单动作或颜色顺序。
为 Aqua 站决定观察什么；讲清全部规则、试玩，再一起修改。

easier.en: Use two collections and one task for each; an adult helps explain.
easier.zh: 用两个系列，各定一个任务，成人协助说明。

variation.en: Invite someone else to redesign one station and try their version.
variation.zh: 邀请同伴改一站，再试玩新版本。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Create animal, color and pause clues for a friend to find a paper treasure.
summary.zh: 设计动物、颜色和停顿线索，让同伴找到纸质宝藏。

setup.en: Use two tiles from each collection and a paper treasure card placed beside the final stop.
setup.zh: 每系列两片，终点旁放一张纸质宝藏卡。

text.en: Children and an adult create a route: start with an animal, then choose a visible color.
text.zh: 孩子和成人编路线线索：从动物起步，再选可见颜色。

text.en: A partner follows the clues through the Color Duos stations while the group helps.
text.zh: 同伴按线索经过双色站点，小组一起提示。

text.en: Pause at an Aqua station before finding the card beside the last stop; swap clue-makers and explorers.
text.zh: 在 Aqua 站停看，再找最后一站旁的卡片，交换出题者与探索者。

en: Children and an adult create a route: start with an animal, then choose a visible color.
A partner follows the clues through the Color Duos stations while the group helps.
Pause at an Aqua station before finding the card beside the last stop; swap clue-makers and explorers.
zh: 孩子和成人编路线线索：从动物起步，再选可见颜色。
同伴按线索经过双色站点，小组一起提示。
在 Aqua 站停看，再找最后一站旁的卡片，交换出题者与探索者。

easier.en: An adult provides two clues; this guided variation is Challenge.
easier.zh: 成人提供两条线索；此执行版本属于 Challenge。

variation.en: Let the children invent a new clue route and explain it to another group.
variation.zh: 孩子自编新线索，向另一组解释。

skills.zh: 线索设计、解决问题、合作。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

title.en: Choose a Color, Choose a Step

summary.en: Choose the next color yourself, explore its pattern, then swap roles.
summary.zh: 自己选下一种颜色，探索纹理，再交换角色。

setup.en: Place 3–8 Color Duos tiles in an open path, with a waiting spot beside it.
setup.zh: 用 3–8 片双色垫排开放路线，旁边留等候点。

text.en: One player points to a visible color on a tile. Naming the color is optional.
text.zh: 一人指向垫上可见颜色，不要求说对色名。

text.en: The explorer steps or presses on it and describes the moving liquid.
text.zh: 探索者踩踏或按压，说说液体变化。

text.en: Swap chooser and explorer; a solo player can do both, with an adult nearby.
text.zh: 交换选择者和探索者；单人可自己完成，成人陪同。

en: One player points to a visible color on a tile. Naming the color is optional.
The explorer steps or presses on it and describes the moving liquid.
Swap chooser and explorer; a solo player can do both, with an adult nearby.
zh: 一人指向垫上可见颜色，不要求说对色名。
探索者踩踏或按压，说说液体变化。
交换选择者和探索者；单人可自己完成，成人陪同。

easier.en: Start with three tiles and allow gestures.
easier.zh: 从三片开始，允许手势回应。

variation.en: Explain your choice; for fixed action rules try Color Command, or for memory try Follow My Path.
variation.zh: 说说为何选这片；固定动作规则可玩颜色指令，记顺序可玩跟着我的路线。

skills.zh: 自主选择、观察、描述、轮流。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Look, press with a hand, then lift your hand and describe the changing pattern.
summary.zh: 先看、用手按压、移开，再描述纹理变化。

setup.en: Place 1–4 Aqua tiles beside a quiet indoor area. Keep books and furniture off them.
setup.zh: 安静室内区域旁平放 1–4 片 Aqua 垫，书本和家具不压在上面。

text.en: Choose a blue or green tile and look at its current pattern.
text.zh: 选蓝色或绿色垫，先看当前纹理。

text.en: Press with a hand and notice where the color moves.
text.zh: 用手按压，观察颜色往哪里移动。

text.en: Lift your hand, keep observing, then invite another player to choose. There is no timer.
text.zh: 移开手继续看，再邀请下一人选择，不设倒计时。

en: Choose a blue or green tile and look at its current pattern.
Press with a hand and notice where the color moves.
Lift your hand, keep observing, then invite another player to choose. There is no timer.
zh: 选蓝色或绿色垫，先看当前纹理。
用手按压，观察颜色往哪里移动。
移开手继续看，再邀请下一人选择，不设倒计时。

easier.en: Use one tile and let an adult demonstrate once.
easier.zh: 只用一片，成人示范一次。

variation.en: Compare the pattern before and after a press. For movement, try Quiet Steps.
variation.zh: 比较按压前后纹理；想加入移动可玩安静脚步。

skills.en: Observation, describing changes and taking turns.
skills.zh: 细节观察、变化描述、轮流。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Use any one eight-tile collection to make a line, grid or gentle curve.
summary.zh: 任一八片系列都可排直线、方阵或缓弯。

setup.en: Start with one collection. Rearrange only while children wait outside the play area.
setup.zh: 使用任一系列一套，孩子在区域外等候时再调整。

text.en: Place tiles one after another, flat and without overlap.
text.zh: 依次单层平放，不重叠。

text.en: Try two rows of four with every border visible.
text.zh: 两行四列，边界可见。

text.en: Change positions to form a gentle turn without blocking a walkway.
text.zh: 改变位置让路线缓转，不堵通道。

en: Place tiles one after another, flat and without overlap.
Try two rows of four with every border visible.
Change positions to form a gentle turn without blocking a walkway.
zh: 依次单层平放，不重叠。
两行四列，边界可见。
改变位置让路线缓转，不堵通道。

variation.en: Add a task using Build a Color Course or Build Your Own Adventure.
variation.zh: 搭配自创彩色挑战或自创冒险加入任务。

skills.en: A setup reference, not a separate game.
skills.zh: 这是布置参考，不是独立游戏。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。

summary.en: Organize chooser, explorer and observer roles for a shared classroom activity.
summary.zh: 用选择者、探索者、观察者组织课堂活动。

setup.en: Choose either suitable collection, use 4–8 tiles and prepare a waiting space with adult supervision.
setup.zh: 任选适用系列，用 4–8 片，在成人监护下设等候区。

text.en: One child points to an animal or visible color.
text.zh: 一人指动物或可见颜色。

text.en: The next child presses or steps; only one child uses a tile at a time.
text.zh: 下一人按压或踩踏，每片一次一人。

text.en: Others describe what they noticed, then rotate roles. Adapt group size to the room.
text.zh: 其他人描述所见，再轮换角色；人数按空间调整。

en: One child points to an animal or visible color.
The next child presses or steps; only one child uses a tile at a time.
Others describe what they noticed, then rotate roles. Adapt group size to the room.
zh: 一人指动物或可见颜色。
下一人按压或踩踏，每片一次一人。
其他人描述所见，再轮换角色；人数按空间调整。

easier.en: Use two roles and demonstrate a turn.
easier.zh: 从两个角色开始，示范一轮。

variation.en: Use these roles alongside a Signature game; multiple compatible products do not make this Mixed Play.
variation.zh: 将角色用于代表玩法；适用多个产品并不等于混合玩法。

skills.en: A group organization reference, not a separate game.
skills.zh: 这是小组组织参考，不是独立游戏。

tip.en: Keep the invitation flexible. Pointing or describing is enough.
tip.zh: 保持邀请开放，指认或描述都可以。
